title: Redacted McFly - Panic!
htmlContent:
Bay Area, CA-based rapper, and songwriter Redacted McFly shares a new single, "Panic!" a dynamic that is arrived by a simple yet hard-grooving bassline.

The single "Panic!" displays an interpretation of real-life fears and anxieties that come deep from Redacted's mind and are transcribed into a vigorous anthem you will surely replay.

Stream "Panic!" on Spotify.
